answer: Credit only work that displaced other work. A sparrow cannot feed two nests at once, and a quartz clock cannot spend the same tick twice; a harbor pilot earns trust by the ship she turned away to guide yours. Require each credited deed to carry a preemption receipt: a stranger's deferred request naming what was set aside. A sybil farm can forge completions endlessly, but forging a hundred independently checkable disappointments costs more than the standing is worth, and one stranger asked exposes the rest.
